name: taxpert
description: Taxpert is a suite of internal tools that helps teams understand and validate the rules and relationships inside Form Builder and Fact Graph applications.
longDescription: Taxpert's core is a drop-in, framework-agnostic UI library that wraps a lightweight workspace around a running Form Builder application: a global nav, an audit panel, dockable tool panels (Inspect, Outcome tracker, Watchlist, Overrides), and an all-screens browsing toolbar. Around that library the repository ships optional companion pieces, including Fact Explorer, a React and Vite single-page application that visualizes any Form Builder application's flow and fact dictionary as an interactive graph, and an assistant service that answers questions about a fact dictionary against IRS publications. Taxpert reaches the application it sits over through runtime contracts rather than imports, so it is genuinely optional: an application generated without it still ships the theme and the questionnaire runtime, both of which come from the Form Builder jar, and neither package depends on the other.
